title: Fix missing dashboard plugin registration in documentation demos
body:
The documentation's `InteractiveDemo` component throws "Unknown component type: dashboard" when rendering dashboard examples.

## Changes

- Added `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` import to plugin loading array in `InteractiveDemo.tsx`

The plugin was registered but never imported, causing `ComponentRegistry.get('dashboard')` to return undefined when rendering doc examples. Other plugins (charts, kanban, timeline, etc.) were already being loaded; dashboard was missing from the list.
